mapper.sql: i.uuid, i.message_id, i.scope_key, i.payload::text AS payload, i.state, i.session_external_id, COALESCE(i.prepared_content::text, '') AS prepared_content, i.input_event_id, i.lease_owner, i.lease_until

i.organization_uuid=#{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND i.workspace_uuid=#{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND i.channel_uuid=#{scope.ChannelUUID} AND i.channel_type=#{scope.ChannelType} AND i.account_id=#{scope.AccountID}
AND i.uuid=#{inputUUID} AND i.lease_owner=#{owner} AND i.lease_until>now()
mapper.select: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE channel_inputs i SET state=CASE WHEN state='received' THEN 'buffering' ELSE state END, lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=now()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.uuid=#{inputUUID} AND i.lease_until<=now() AND i.state IN ('received','buffering','prepared','accepted') RETURNING uuid,message_id,scope_key,payload,state,session_external_id,prepared_content,input_event_id,lease_owner,lease_until ) SELECT FROM changed i
SELECT FROM channel_inputs i WHERE AND i.state IN ('received','buffering','prepared','accepted') AND i.lease_until<=now() ORDER BY i.created_at,i.uuid LIMIT 100
mapper.update: WITH pairing AS ( SELECT p.status,p.remote_id FROM channel_pairings p WHERE p.organization_uuid=#{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND p.workspace_uuid=#{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND p.channel_uuid=#{scope.ChannelUUID} AND p.platform_account=#{scope.AccountID} AND p.scope_kind='direct' AND p.external_id=CAST(#{patch} AS jsonb)->>'pairing_id' FOR UPDATE ) UPDATE channel_inputs i SET state=CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pairing p WHERE p.status='active' AND p.remote_id=i.payload->>'user_id') THEN 'received' ELSE 'pairing_wait' END, lease_owner='',lease_until=now(),payload=payload || CAST(#{patch} AS jsonb),updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.state='buffering'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM channel_inputs i WHERE AND i.uuid=#{inputUUID}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_inputs i WHERE AND i.scope_key=#{input.ScopeKey} AND i.message_id=#{input.MessageID})

SELECT FROM channel_inputs i WHERE AND i.scope_key=#{batch.ScopeKey} AND i.state='buffering' AND i.lease_owner=#{owner} AND i.lease_until>now() AND i.message_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.created_at,i.uuid FOR UPDATE

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE channel_inputs i SET state='prepared',payload=#{batch.Payload,sensitive=true}::jsonb,lease_until=now()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.state='buffering' RETURNING uuid,message_id,scope_key,payload,state,session_external_id,prepared_content,input_event_id,lease_owner,lease_until ) SELECT FROM changed i

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE channel_inputs i SET state=#{change.State},session_external_id=#{change.SessionExternalID}, payload=CASE WHEN #{change.State}='accepted' THEN payload-'content'-'resources' ELSE payload END, prepared_content=NULLIF(#{change.PreparedContent,sensitive=true},'')::jsonb, input_event_id=#{change.InputEventID},lease_until=now()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.state IN ('prepared','accepted') RETURNING uuid,message_id,scope_key,payload,state,session_external_id,prepared_content,input_event_id,lease_owner,lease_until ), sources AS ( UPDATE channel_inputs i SET payload=payload-'content'-'resources',prepared_content=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.parent_uuid=#{inputUUID} AND #{change.State}='accepted' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed) ) SELECT FROM changed i

WITH completed AS ( UPDATE channel_inputs i SET state='handed_off',payload=payload-'content'-'resources',prepared_content=NULL, lease_owner='',lease_until=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.state IN ('prepared','accepted','command_sending') RETURNING uuid ), sources AS ( UPDATE channel_inputs i SET state='handed_off',payload=payload-'content'-'resources',prepared_content=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE AND i.parent_uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM completed) ) SELECT uuid::text AS uuid FROM completed
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_inputs i SET lease_until=now()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE AND i.lease_owner=#{owner} AND i.lease_until>now() AND i.state IN ('prepared','accepted','command_sending')
